root_cause: The workflow reused tracked sync-candidates/results from an earlier stem-based run. The current generator produced one fresh report, while 19 stale reports remained; their audio hashes did not match the freshly frozen manifests.

evidence.failed_error: hash de audio del candidato no coincide

fixes: run_all_sync_candidates.sh now removes sync-candidates/logs and sync-candidates/results before generating.
validate_sync_candidates.py now requires exactly 20 manifests and validates report song, audio path and analysis audio hash.
The validator now prints per-song errors to stderr for actionable GitHub Actions logs.
